premises.meaning: The trusted approval set faithfully represents actual review of the exact definition.
Owned definitions represent intended source meanings; generic labels and record-only prose do not establish this.
The required obligation list is independently derived from the owned profile and diff, never selected by the submitted result.
Verified evidence establishes its challenge under the pinned semantic definitions and allowed premises.
Verified support has permitted issuer/policy and exact action/output provenance; the current model checks criterion, requirement, frame and positive value.
Expression environment values are supplied observations; their external-world truth is not proved by evaluation.
Raw bytes decode to the formal typed objects and digest bindings faithfully identify their content.
The pinned compiler, core library and host execute faithfully; a binary hash is a binding, not a proof of host correctness.
Clock, source completeness and revocation observations support the chosen as-of claims.
